caption: The drawing features a fragment of a decorative design, centrally placed on a plain, off-white background. The main elements consist of a vertical, stylized plant motif with six orange-brown leaves outlined in black, arranged alternately along a central stem. This motif is placed next to a right-angle border design made up of two bands: the thicker, inner band is yellow with a black outline, while the thinner, outer band is solid black. The corner created by these bands contains a textured fill of orange-brown color, resembling a section of painted wall. The design appears incomplete, with its edges faded and irregular, giving the impression of a fragment. The artist’s signature, “W. Wiechhofel,” is located in the lower right corner in small, reddish-brown text.
title: Wall Painting (Fragment)
